# Kridhya by Devanshi Agarwal

> Small joys worn close to heart. Thoughtfully designed fine jewellery from India - pendants, earrings, bracelets, rings, necklaces and brooches in gold, rose gold and silver finishes - for everyday elegance, meaningful gifting and corporate gifting.

Prices are in Indian rupees (INR). Orders can be placed on the website or on WhatsApp (+91 94135 48001). Customers track orders at https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/track-order.

## Shop
- [All jewellery](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/shop): the full catalogue with filters by category and finish
- [Pendants](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/collections/pendants): Infinity pendants and charms on fine gold-plated chains.
- [Earrings](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/collections/earrings): Drops, studs and climbers for every day.
- [Bracelets](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/collections/bracelets): Cuffs and slim bracelets, hand-set and gold-plated.
- [Rings](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/collections/rings): Stacking and statement rings in gold-plated finishes.
- [Necklaces](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/collections/necklaces): Layered strands and heart-and-infinity necklaces.
- [Brooches](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/collections/brooches): A finishing flourish for sarees, blazers and shawls.

## Journal
- [The Quiet Art of Layering Fine Necklaces](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/blog/how-to-layer-fine-necklaces): Three lengths, one mood. A simple framework for layering delicate chains so each piece still has room to breathe.
- [A Gentle Guide to Caring for Your Jewellery](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/blog/caring-for-your-jewellery): Small habits that keep fine pieces bright - from storage and cleaning to the order you get dressed in.
- [Endless Lines: Why the Infinity Motif Endures](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/blog/meaning-of-the-infinity-symbol): A continuous loop with no beginning and no end - why this simple shape has become a language for lasting bonds.
- [Thoughtful Corporate Gifting, Made Personal](https://kridhyabydevanshi.com/blog/corporate-gifting-guide): How to choose jewellery gifts for teams, clients and celebrations that feel considered rather than corporate.
